Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲, by the way, did you watch that thing the other day？
Eh？
You know what I mean. 'Wandering Stopover Towns.'
Oh, that TV travel show. No, I didn't watch it.
Come on, you should've watched it!
Oh, you didn't see it...
Well then, do you know Enoshima？
Enoshima？ Well, more or less.
I hear it's a great place. Not too close, not too far, and just right for a day trip, you know？
Really...？
Plus, Enoshima is in Shonan! And Shonan means youth, right？ It's practically a rite of passage for teenagers!
A rite of passage？ Not sure I follow, but... Are you saying you wanna go？
Huh, me？ Hmm, I don't know about that~ I just figured YOU wanted to go.
Me？ Well, let's see...
You want to go, don't you？ ...Right？
All right, wanna go check it out then？
Yes! Then it's settled! A samurai never goes back on his word, so starting today, you're a samurai! Hehe!
(▲小早川＊▲ must really want to go...)
Let's see, where's ▲小早川＊▲...？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲？
Hehe...
▲小早川＊▲... You're dressed up more than usual today, aren't you？
Well, I mean, of course... You know？
Anyway, never mind that! Come on, let's go! Our youth is waiting for us!
You're really into this, ▲小早川＊▲. All right, let's go!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲! You're early.
Hehe... Well, we're going to Enoshima today, right？
▲小早川＊▲... Did you dress up a little more than usual today？
Yep, 'cause it's Enoshima, you know？
All right, I will!
Kobayakawa
One question.
What？
Listen, this train is the Enoden, right？ Does that mean we're in Shonan？
...I'd think so？ Why？
All I've seen out the window are houses, so... it doesn't feel very Shonan, does it？
We caught a glimpse of the ocean back around Kugenuma, didn't we？
Hmm...
No, gotta stay positive. Shonan starts once you're on the Enoden. Let's go with that.
What kind of rule is that...？ Well, sure, why not？
That's right, Shonan is all a state of mind. Let's stay positive, jan♪ Oh, since we're in Shonan now, I'll be saying 'jan' a lot, okay？
Kobayakawa
Hey, hey.
Hm？
Riding the Enoden really gets you excited, huh？
It really makes you feel like you're on a trip.
Yeah. It really does.
Hey, mind if I go up to the very front？
Sure, but— Oh...
She's gone...
Phew, we're here~ So this is Enoshima...
Kobayakawa
Hey, um... Just to be sure, quick question. This IS Enoshima, right？
Pretty sure？ The sign says Enoshima Station.
Where's the ocean？ Or for that matter, Enoshima？
I think I caught a glimpse of it from the train earlier.
Don't tell me it IS Enoshima, just a totally different one with the same name？
No way... Anyway, how about we head south a bit first？ Come on, stay positive!
Save the pep talk. *sigh*...
-Hey.
Phew, we're here~.
Kobayakawa
Ahh~! I really love this place. Enoden Enoshima Station has such a nice vibe!
Even though you can't see the ocean or Enoshima.
You just don't get it.
If you just close your eyes and listen closely like this, see, you can hear the waves...
...Or maybe I kind of feel like I can almost hear them.
Okay, okay, I get it. Come on, let's go!
Kobayakawa
Come on, this way! Hurry, hurry!
Hey, wait up!
Whoa, Enoshima!
Here we are, Enoshima... An island floating out there! A lighthouse, a shining sea! Now this is more like it!
Yeah, now this feels like Enoshima!
Yeah... What a great view...
Who was it that said, "Maybe it's another Enoshima"？ That's pretty rude to Mr. Enoshima, you know.
Yeah, well, you're the one who said it, ▲小早川＊▲.
Oh right, hehe. Sorry about that, Mr. Enoshima. Let's go!
Nice weather again today. You can really see the island.
Kobayakawa
I'm back, Enoshima. Came to visit again.
You've really taken a liking to Enoshima, huh.
Well, yeah. It's practically Rinko's turf at this point. Ahh~, green island! Blue sea! Long bridge!
...It really is kinda long, though, Benten Bridge...
A bit much to cross on foot, yeah...
Kobayakawa
Well, it's a good time for it, so maybe we should...
Scared of what？
Oh, come on. Like you weren't hoping for it.
Oh, don't tell me!
That's right. It's Rinko's Lunch Box in Enoshima.
Awesome! So it's packed with Enoshima specialties？
There aren't any in it, so the name's doing all the work. Come on, find us a spot with a nice view!
Alright. Where should we go first...？
Let's go with ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲.
Kobayakawa
Yeah. Might be better to head there first. Okay.
Thanks for the food!
Kobayakawa
You're welcome. ...There're plenty of Enoshima specialties on the island, so think of a homemade lunch as a Rinko specialty.
True enough. Alright, now that we've had lunch, next up...
Since we came all this way, let's go to the Samuel Cocking Garden. Come on, we gotta hit the lighthouse too, right？
Alright, let's go!
Alright... Guess it's about time for that place...
We're going to ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲, right？
Kobayakawa
Of course. Let's go!
Next up has gotta be that place, huh...
Wanna check out ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Let's. Hehe, I was thinking the same thing.
Kobayakawa
Mmm... The sea breeze really is different here in Shonan!
Guess so. Glad we came, huh？
Yeah. Oh... Look, a cat! Hey there, kitty~♪
Oh, you're right.
Here, kitty kitty~♪
No reaction, huh... Pretty full of himself.
Hey, you'll hurt his feelings! Oh...
There he goes.
Yeah. Didn't even run away. Just strolled right off. ...Wonder where he's going.
Wanna follow him for a bit？
That sounds fun! ...Actually, never mind. Let's pass on that today.
Come on, let's go!
Kobayakawa
Huff, huff...
Hm？ Want to take a little break if you're tired？
Not at all？ Just taking deep breaths of the sea breeze...
I see.
The Escar, huh... Pretty clever idea.
...Wanna rest？
I'm fine-- Oh! Look, it's him again! That ginger tabby's looking right at us. Hey there.
He walked off again... Not running, just dawdling. Do you think... he's looking down on us？
Could be...
Kobayakawa
Haaah...
Getting a little tired, ▲小早川＊▲？
I'm fine.
I see.
What do you think I'd do if I were put in charge of all of Enoshima？
In charge？ ...What would you do？
I would install Escars on every single hill.
(She really is tired.)
Oh, look! There he is again! That big ginger tabby!
Where？
He's already gone... He was looking at us again.
Wait, do you think he's trying to tell us to follow him？
Kobayakawa
Mmm... The breeze really is different here in Shonan!
Yeah？ Glad we came, huh？
Yeah. Thanks for bringing me.
You're welcome.
Hey, ▲主人公＊▲. You know what？ You've got a real breezy Shonan boy vibe today.
(Kind of embarrassing...)
Kobayakawa
Mmm! Nice, very nice! So many souvenir shops!
Lots of tourists, too. Real textbook tourist spot.
True. Normally this might be a bit much for me. But I'm all geared up today.
Geared up？ How come？
Well, that's... Because I'm a Shonan girl today, obviously？ Oh, something smells good!
Grilled turban shells？ Wanna try some？
Turban shells, though... That gory-looking bit at the end is a little much... Oh, what's that？ Look at those retro bottles.
It says "Shonan Cider."
Ooh! I think I'll go with that!
Kobayakawa
They say Hetsunomiya here enshrines the Naked Benten, one of Japan's three great Benten statues.
She's a matchmaking goddess, but people used to say she'd get jealous of couples who visit and break them up.
Huh, you really know a lot about this, huh？
I guess？
A naked Benten, huh...
Hm？ Are you thinking something sacrilegious right now？
No way!
Kobayakawa
Ugh... We went down so many stairs, my knees are shaking...
The Iwaya caves are... just a bit further ahead.
Really builds up the anticipation, huh...
Whoa, it's so cool in here!
They've got all sorts of effects set up. It's really well maintained.
Yeah, right. This place is also tied to the five-headed dragon and the celestial maiden...
The celestial maiden？
...Huh？ Did I say that？ Come on, let's head a little further inside, okay？
Kobayakawa
It's as lively as ever here.
Yeah. And it always smells so good no matter when we come.
The grilled turban shells, huh. They do smell good, I'll admit.
Want to take the plunge and try one this time？
People become adults the moment they acquire a taste for turban shells, you know.
Is that how it works？
And I'd like to stay a kid just a little bit longer.
...So in other words, you're not eating one？
I'm gonna get in line for the whole-octopus crackers.
Kobayakawa
Hey, could you walk a little bit away from me？
Hm？ ...Are you mad at me？
It's not that... You know, if we look too close, Benten might...
Get jealous, right？ That's just superstition. Besides, she's actually a matchmaking goddess.
Still, you never know for sure, right？
▲小早川＊▲... All right, just a little, okay？
Yeah. Just for a little while, okay？
Kobayakawa
An Escar escalator... Still haven't built one, huh.
Give it up already.
Looking at it like this, the Dragon God in here really feels like the final boss.
The one at Ryugu Shrine is bigger, though, right？
Hmm... With the glowing stone effect and being deep in a cave, this one's totally the final boss.
True enough. Hmm...
Hey, I have a suggestion.
Maybe we should actually read the info signs for once. We're not grade-schoolers anymore...
Yeah, sure.
Kobayakawa
Hmm... So this whole area used to be Mr. Samuel's garden.
Yeah, it's huge.
Oh, look over there! You can see the lighthouse!
All right, let's head up.
Amazing!
All right!
It feels way higher up here than it looked from down below.
Well, it's built right at the top of the island.
Yeah... You can see all of Shonan. Oh, I found Eboshi Rock.
It pops up in song lyrics a lot. And that's Kamakura over there, huh.
Whoa! The wind's strong! Feels great, though! Like textbook youth!
Yeah, I'm glad we came.
Let's check out the other side! Come on, catch me if you can!
Hey, don't run! That's taking the youth thing way too far!
Kobayakawa
Oh, look! The Dragon Palace!
Yeah. That's definitely a dragon...
Sure is... Enoshima kind of feels like an RPG, doesn't it？ With celestial maidens and dragons.
You see them depicted all over the place here.
Right, right. What if all of that is foreshadowing, and this is the final boss's cave？
What do you want me to say to that...? Well, I guess it'd be a quest.
Then go forth, Chosen Hero, and slay the dragon!
Huh？ I'm the hero？
That's right. Princess Rinko will wait right here. Go finish it off!
So this is Chigogafuchi... Looking at it like this, you can really tell it's raised seafloor.
Kobayakawa
Yeah... They say the Iwaya caves are also called the Dragon Caves. It really feels like a dragon could live there.
I can see why.
By the way, isn't there an Escar around here？
The Escar？ You mean those escalators connecting the shrines？ I don't think there's one back here.
*sigh*... Didn't think so.
Did you want to ride the Escar that badly？
Well, I really do right now. I just remembered all those stairs we walked down earlier...
Good point. We have to climb all the way back up those now...
Kobayakawa
Hey, Mr. Photographer. Doesn't this spot have a nice vibe？
Yeah, let's take a picture.
Hehe!
Kobayakawa
Oh, this spot looks nice. Very Enoshima.
All right, let's take a picture.
Hehe!
Kobayakawa
Hey, since we're here, will you take a picture of me here too？
Yeah, sure.
Huh？ What's this？
Kobayakawa
What is it？ Let me see too.
Whoa... How did this happen？
I don't know, maybe a trick of the light from the angle of the sun and the lens...
Still, look at it... It kind of looks like...
Yeah. It looks just like a celestial maiden's feathered robe...
I bet that ginger tabby gave it to us as a present... Let's treasure it, okay？
Hm？
Kobayakawa
What, did it not come out right？
No, could this be...
Wait! Don't tell me it happened again？
Yes! Another photo of the feathered robe!
Yeah.
Amazing... I wonder if coincidences like this happen a lot...
Either that, or ▲小早川＊▲ really is a celestial maiden...
If I am... will you be my dragon？
Of course I did.
Hehe, we'll be together forever, right？
Well then... The sun's starting to go down soon.
Kobayakawa
Hmm... I wonder if we passed it somewhere along the way...
What's wrong？
Well, there was still somewhere I wanted to go, but it's getting late, so maybe next—
Oh, it's that ginger tabby... Wait a second, I'm going to go say hi.
I lost sight of it again... I'm pretty sure it went down this path...
It says the 'Bell of Dragon's Love' is just ahead.
'Bell of Dragon's Love'... That might be it!
Kobayakawa
Well then... We got to enjoy Enoshima again today, and the sun's starting to set...
Come on, there's one last place we have to go, right？
Oh, right. Alright, let's go!
The sunset's incredible... Is this where you wanted to come, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. Apparently the legend of the celestial maiden and the five-headed dragon is written on that bell.
'The Celestial Maiden and the Five-Headed Dragon'？
Long ago, a five-headed dragon that only did bad things fell in love with this island's celestial maiden, had a change of heart, and protected the people.
And based on the legend of the maiden and the dragon coming together, lovers who ring this bell...
will stay together forever, they say.
▲小早川＊▲... Is that why you wanted to come here？
Yeah. And besides...
Kobayakawa
Doesn't this remind you？ You know, back in Atami...
'Cape Aijo'？
It's a little similar, isn't it？
You're right.
Kobayakawa
Doesn't it remind you？ You know, when I was on the roof...
When you confessed to me？
Kobayakawa
I saw this place on TV, and it brought all those memories back.
Even now, just being with you like this makes me want to cry sometimes.
I wanted to tell you that one more time, right here...
You could've just said so from the start.
Well, if I say cheesy, youthful stuff like that with a straight face, I feel like you'll laugh at me.
I wouldn't laugh... Thank you.
Yeah... Hey, I don't think anyone's looking right now...
I love you... Hehe... Should we ring the bell？
Alright.
!! That wasn't quite what I imagined.
A surprisingly deep sound, huh？
Still, it sounds like it'll bring us luck.
True.
What a sunset... Is this where you wanted to come, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. Did you figure out why？
That's...
Here's a hint, then.
Kobayakawa
There are lots of padlocks all around that bell. ...Looks familiar, right？
Oh... Cape Aijo？
Very good. Hehe, looks a bit like it, right？
It really does.
Kobayakawa
We saw such a beautiful sunset from the roof that day, too...
Right, the day you confessed to me—
Never mind! It's a little embarrassing...
Kobayakawa
I saw this place on TV, and it brought it all back. I wanted to say it again...
I get shy easily, so I figured with this place's help, I could say it properly.
▲主人公＊▲. I'll always love you...
▲小早川＊▲... Me too.
Want to ring the bell？
That bell？
Yeah. The legend of the celestial maiden and the five-headed dragon is written on it.
Long ago, a wicked five-headed dragon fell in love with this island's celestial maiden, had a change of heart, and protected the people.
And based on the legend of the maiden and the dragon coming together, lovers who ring this bell...
They say they'll stay together forever.
▲小早川＊▲... Is that why you wanted to come here？
Yeah. It's not really like me, so it was hard to bring up.
I see. All right, let's ring it!
!! Kind of a traditional Japanese sound, huh？
Has a sacred ring to it...
Well, that's fine. This is a memory just for the two of us, right？
Yeah, sure.
Hey... We're all alone right now, you know？
Yeah.
Geez... Come on, over here. Just come a little closer.
Hehe... Tasted like the sea breeze.
Well, we are in Shonan.
What a sunset... Is this where you wanted to come, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Yeah... I thought I'd borrow that bell's power.
The bell's power？
Once upon a time, a wicked five-headed dragon fell in love with this island's celestial maiden. To win her love, he reformed and protected people.
And they say the maiden and the dragon were joined forever. So lovers who ring this bell...
They say they'll stay together forever.
I see...
Plus... Come on, doesn't it remind you of something？
Kobayakawa
All those locks hanging up around it, just like that bell...
Oh... Aijo Cape in Atami？
Hehe, you remembered.
Of course I did.
Kobayakawa
When I... you know, up on the school rooftop...
When you confessed to me？
Kobayakawa
Yeah... I saw it on TV and it brought it all back. Hey, wanna ring the bell？
Alright...
!! Huh？ That didn't sound how I imagined it would.
Sounds like a temple bell...
Yeah. Still, I think it gave me a little courage.
Look... I'm not very brave, so I know I can be a pain like this sometimes...
But I really, truly love you. I want to stay with you...
Yeah, let's stay together.
Did my feelings... really get through to you？
Yeah, they did.
Then... do you know what I want to do next？
It really is a little embarrassing...
The sunset really is great up here...
Kobayakawa
Yeah. Feels like the end of a day-long adventure.
An adventure？
"The Heavenly Maiden & the 5-Headed Dragon." It's written in English right by the bell.
"The Heavenly Maiden and Five-Headed Dragon," huh. Really sounds like an RPG.
Hey, hey, what about the ending？
The ending？ What should we do？
Okay, so... First, the dragon and the princess ring the bell.
I'm the dragon？
Did you want to be the princess instead？
I'll stick with the dragon.
!! That sound really is very traditional, huh.
Fits a heavenly maiden and dragon better, doesn't it？
Okay, back to the story. And then, the dragon...
gently kissed the heavenly maiden...
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲! The train's almost here!
Kobayakawa
Sorry, sorry! Kept you waiting.
Did you buy something？
Kind of. Look.
Oh, a dragon strap!
Yep. ...What do you think？ He's pretty handsome for a dragon, right？
You think so？ I feel like there've gotta be cooler ones out there.
Hmm, maybe there were, but... who cares？ I like this one! Hehe!
I see. Maybe I should buy one of those too？
Listen... What're you gonna do with a dragon？ If you buy one, it should be the world's cutest celestial maiden, right？
Oh, the train's here! Hurry!
(Looks like this made a nice memory for ▲小早川＊▲...)
Kobayakawa
It's kind of mysterious.
Mysterious？
When evening comes, this station feels less like a trip and more like the one back in my own town...
Yeah. I think I know what you mean...
It's almost like it's telling us to hurry on home.
You know, coming to Enoshima really brings out the maiden in you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Huh？ I'm always a maiden, I'll have you know!
Ow...
The train's here! Come on, hurry!
(A maiden's heart sure is complicated...)
